title: zcurve-evidential-v1 task input
description: A set of statistically-significant test results, summarised as their z-scores (all |z|>1.96). The player must judge whether the set reflects genuine underlying effects (evidential value) or is consistent with selection-for-significance over null/weak effects (no evidential value / p-hacked). The reference tool is the R package `zcurve`.

study_set_id.description: Stable id for this set of significant studies.

z_scores.description: The significant test results as z-scores. Every value exceeds the significance threshold (|z|>1.96).

n_studies.description: Number of significant studies in the set (equals len(z_scores)).
